facts.fact: Journalists Syndicate head Khaled El-Balshy announced a bill regulating the right to access information had been submitted to the House of Representatives, adopted by MP Maha Abdel Nasser with 60 MPs' signatures, per Al Jazeera Net.

MP Maha Abdel Nasser says she filed a 24-article freedom of information bill, prepared with the Journalists Syndicate, in the House of Representatives in the last week of its first session, and the explanatory memorandum says the legislation Article 68 of the constitution calls for is still absent.
facts.system: Freedom of Information Bill (Abdel Nasser / Journalists Syndicate)

facts.fact: ARTICLE 19 says Egypt does not have effective right-to-information legislation, despite years of discussion of draft laws.
